chemistry-e6-q2.title: Idan aka digo dilute
chemistry-e6-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-e6-q2.material: Idan aka digo dilute hydrochloric acid ko vinegar a kan ƙwan kwai ko guntun marmara (mai sinadarin calcium carbonate), kumfa yana fitowa. Menene zai faru idan aka tara gas ɗin aka ratsa shi ta cikin lime water?

chemistry-e6-q3.title: Menene ƙa'idar kimiyya ta
chemistry-e6-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-e6-q3.material: Menene ƙa'idar kimiyya ta hikimar rayuwar yau da kullum ta yayyafa ruwan lemun tsami ko vinegar don kawar da wari na kifi (trimethylamine mai halin basic, da sauransu) a lokacin dafa kifi?

chemistry-killer-06.title: Kewayen canjin launi na
chemistry-killer-06.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-06.material:
Kewayen canjin launi na indicators kamar haka ne.
Methyl orange: pH < 3.1 ja, 3.1 ~ 4.4 lemu, pH > 4.4 rawaya
BTB: pH < 6.0 rawaya, 6.0 ~ 7.6 kore, pH > 7.6 shuɗi
Phenolphthalein: pH < 8.3 babu launi, 8.3 ~ 10.0 ruwan hoda, pH > 10.0 ja
Waɗannan sakamakon digar kowanne daga indicators uku ne a cikin maganin ruwa uku na rayuwar yau da kullum.
(I) Samfurin acid na ciki: methyl orange ja, BTB rawaya, phenolphthalein babu launi
(II) Maganin bayan isasshen amsawa da maganin antacid: methyl orange rawaya, BTB rawaya, phenolphthalein babu launi
(III) Maganin dilute na ruwa na sodium hydrogen carbonate: methyl orange rawaya, BTB shuɗi, phenolphthalein babu launi
Idan aka tantance mafi ƙuntataccen kewayen pH da ya dace da sakamakon indicators uku duka, wane haɗi ne ya nuna daidai da jeri kewayen pH na (I), (II) da (III)?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.prompt:
Kewayen canjin launi na indicators kamar haka ne.
Methyl orange: pH < 3.1 ja, 3.1 ~ 4.4 lemu, pH > 4.4 rawaya
BTB: pH < 6.0 rawaya, 6.0 ~ 7.6 kore, pH > 7.6 shuɗi
Phenolphthalein: pH < 8.3 babu launi, 8.3 ~ 10.0 ruwan hoda, pH > 10.0 ja
Waɗannan sakamakon digar kowanne daga indicators uku ne a cikin maganin ruwa uku na rayuwar yau da kullum.
(I) Samfurin acid na ciki: methyl orange ja, BTB rawaya, phenolphthalein babu launi
(II) Maganin bayan isasshen amsawa da maganin antacid: methyl orange rawaya, BTB rawaya, phenolphthalein babu launi
(III) Maganin dilute na ruwa na sodium hydrogen carbonate: methyl orange rawaya, BTB shuɗi, phenolphthalein babu launi
Idan aka tantance mafi ƙuntataccen kewayen pH da ya dace da sakamakon indicators uku duka, wane haɗi ne ya nuna daidai da jeri kewayen pH na (I), (II) da (III)?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.explain:
(I): methyl orange ja pH < 3.1, BTB rawaya pH < 6.0, phenolphthalein babu launi pH < 8.3. Kewayen gama gari pH < 3.1.
(II): methyl orange rawaya pH > 4.4, BTB rawaya pH < 6.0, phenolphthalein babu launi pH < 8.3. Kewayen gama gari 4.4 < pH < 6.0.
(III): methyl orange rawaya pH > 4.4, BTB shuɗi pH > 7.6, phenolphthalein babu launi pH < 8.3. Kewayen gama gari 7.6 < pH < 8.3.
Amsa: (I) pH < 3.1, (II) 4.4 < pH < 6.0, (III) 7.6 < pH < 8.3 (b). (Kuskure: (I) a matsayin kewayen lemu 3.1 ~ 4.4 rikicewar ja da lemu ne, (II) a matsayin 6.0 ~ 7.6 rikicewar rawaya da kore na BTB ne, kuma zaɓi na ƙarshe yana amfani da kewayen indicator ɗaya na BTB, don haka ba shi ne mafi ƙuntataccen kewaye ba)
chemistry-killer-06.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
